topic: Fridge and freezer in a power cut: what to eat first

content.hook: POV: the power's out and your fridge is full

slides.title: POV: power's out and your *fridge* is full
slides.body: What to eat first. Keep the doors shut.

slides.title: *Fridge* food goes first
slides.body: Closed, it stays cold about 4 hours. Eat dairy, leftovers, cooked meat and fish first.

slides.title: Then *freezer*, then pantry
slides.body: A full freezer holds about 48 hours, if shut. Use thawing items first. Cans and dry food last.

content.caption:
Food safety in a power cut: what to eat first when your fridge is full. Here's the calm version.

Keep doors shut as much as you can. A closed fridge stays cold for about 4 hours. A full freezer holds for about 48 hours, a half-full one about 24.

Eat in this order:
1. Fridge: dairy, leftovers, cooked meat and fish
2. Freezer: whatever thaws first
3. Pantry: cans, dry food, crackers

Past the 4-hour mark, don't taste-test. When in doubt, throw it out. A cheap fridge thermometer helps.
